description: Higher-quality transparent China-stage female archaeologist sprite atlas. Uses full source atlas regions rather than forced cell normalization so hats, expressive faces, dynamic poses, and golden swing arcs are preserved.
runtimeNotes: Uses existing Journey row-aware player renderer with alpha-trimmed variable atlas regions.
China-specific visual identity only; no duplicate player controller, hitbox model, or animation state machine.
Ground line is stored per region so larger production art lands cleanly on the platform.
Integrated attack frames own the pick and golden swing arc; the runtime suppresses duplicate external weapon/arc during attack.
Runtime regions are cut to the transparent row bands so walk and run frames do not pull in neighbouring animation rows.
Legacy sprite fallback remains available through the existing loader.
